title: English Around the World
text:
English is spoken by many people around the world. It is the first language of millions of people in countries such as the United States, Canada, and Australia. Many more people speak English as a second language. Because of this, English is often called a global language.

People use English for travel, business, and science. For example, pilots and air traffic controllers use English when they talk to each other. Students also learn English online to meet people from other countries. Learning English can help people find new jobs and make friends.

questions.text: Which country is mentioned in paragraph one as a place where English is a first language?
According to paragraph two, who uses English when they talk to each other?
Why is English often called a global language?
options: Because only one country speaks it
Because many people around the world use it
Because it is the hardest language to learn

questions.text: Why might a person learn English to find a new job?
options: Because English is only used in schools
Because many businesses around the world use English
Because English is easy to write
Because jobs in English are always free

paragraph_translations: El inglés lo hablan muchas personas en todo el mundo. Es la primera lengua de millones de personas en países como Estados Unidos, Canadá y Australia. Muchas otras personas hablan inglés como segunda lengua. Por eso, el inglés se suele llamar lengua mundial.

La gente usa el inglés para viajar, para los negocios y para la ciencia. Por ejemplo, los pilotos y los controladores aéreos usan inglés cuando hablan entre ellos. Los estudiantes también aprenden inglés en línea para conocer personas de otros países. Aprender inglés puede ayudar a las personas a encontrar nuevos trabajos y a hacer amigos.
